address: 1 Montrose Terrace, Edinburgh, EH7 5DJ, United Kingdom
bio: Located close to The Palace of Holyroodhouse, this 19th-century former inn has been converted into a wine bar and restaurant by the owners of Timberyard. Soft lighting and exposed stonework give the place a rustic, intimate feel, with diners spread across two floors. On the lower level you'll find the bar, where you can pop in for a glass from the excellent wine list championing lesser-known regions. When dining, you can expect dishes characterised by their big, bold flavours and Scottish produce....
